about: The maker codes in Pop Boll device serials, PB####-<MAKER>-<hardware id>. Published at https://popboll.com/makers. tools/generate.py packages this file as bollardeck.device._makers; read it through bollardeck.device.identity.

makers.name: Pop Boll (Arduino UNO Q boards)
makers.notes: A Bolltridge cart built on the Arduino UNO Q. Every serial from before the registry existed carries it.

makers.name: Pop Boll (Raspberry Pi 5 / Compute Module 5 boards)
makers.notes: A Bolltridge cart built on a Raspberry Pi (Compute Module 5). The only code with a digit; third-party codes are letters only.

makers.name: The simulator
makers.notes: A dev machine, a VM or a container. Never a shipped device.

makers.name: Virtual Bolls on popboll.com
makers.notes: Used in virtual serials (VPB0007-WEB-...). Not a physical device.

makers.name: Cloud test devices
makers.notes: Used in virtual serials (VPB0007-CLOUD-...). Not a physical device.

makers.name: Test peers
makers.notes: The USB swap and jam test peer (PB0002-PEER-99887766). Not a physical device.

makers.name: Test peers over USB
makers.notes: The appliance's USB swap test peer (PB0002-USB-PEER-774411). Not a physical device.

makers.name: Documentation example
makers.notes: An example of an admitted maker on these pages. Never assigned.

makers.name: Documentation example
makers.notes: An example of a refused maker on these pages. Never assigned.
